\section{Evidence mapping after owner adoption}

\begin{longtable}{p{0.20\linewidth}p{0.31\linewidth}p{0.40\linewidth}}
\toprule
Requirement group & Required evidence & Discriminating coverage\\
\midrule
\endhead
UFC-REQ-001--010 & Source/Registry identity, algebraic, publication,
representation, and lifecycle conformance & Exact one and singleton/empty
support; analytic normalization; compact and enumerated forms; independent
unit completion; shared fact references; immutable replay.\\
UFC-REQ-011--018 & Profile, truth-algebra, request, scope, and four-axis
conformance & UFC-MIX-001--010; named request with wrong family; permission
denial versus unknown/conflict; successful negative evaluation versus failed
artifact; advisory facts neutral.\\
UFC-REQ-019--024 & Meaning, consumer boundary, rank provenance, fallback, NOI,
and change-control conformance & No precision/default meaning; MAP/JINC
permission isolation; ordinary-rank failures; PTC-disabled separation; exact
NOI parent; family version versus realization.\\
UFC-REQ-025 & Evidence-layer reporting & Algebraic, implementation,
representation/response, observational, and readiness claims reported
separately with exact identities.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

Conformance evidence must bind the exact approved source, Registry record,
application, \(q\), \(g\), support reference or enumeration, payload, request,
consumer, and evaluation identities. It must exercise all T/F/U/C
compositions and preserve every cause. Successful scan/segment/chunk evidence
must show that an independently complete unit can be handed off before
unrelated observation units without labeling partial required output complete.

Scientific validation remains separate and future. Comparative performance or
suitability would require owner-approved populations, questions, metrics,
uncertainty treatment, and criteria. No larger observational program is
invented for the algebraic identity \(1=1\), and no implementation has been
inspected.

\else

\section{Consequences that distinguish the proposal}

A known non-one scalar or authoritative corruption makes the shared payload
invalid even when another fidelity fact is unknown. An unexplained unreadable
payload remains unknown. A faithful payload paired with a MAP denial remains
faithful while MAP use is ineligible; missing MAP permission evidence leaves
the MAP decision unavailable. These distinctions preserve causes instead of
turning every failure into either corruption or absence.

A compact exact support reference is scientifically sufficient when it binds
the correct immutable support. Enumerated storage remains permitted but must
contain every and only each target identity once. Shared facts can be reused
through exact references, while a malformed occurrence request stays local.
These rules preserve exact association without requiring an array of ones or
a separately copied decision record for every sample.

The proposal predicts identical coefficient values across independently
completed segment, scan, or chunk publications, while their realization
identities remain distinct. It also predicts that a valid coefficient does
not rescue invalid signal data, change MAP or JINC gates, or complete a
missing NOI parent. These are future conformance tests, not evidence about an
implementation.

\fi
